# Dockerfile (for Cloud Run deployment)
FROM python:3.10-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD exec gunicorn --bind :$PORT --workers 1 --threads 8 --timeout 0 app:flask_app

# .gitignore
.env
__pycache__/
*.py[cod]
*$py.class
venv/
.idea/
.vscode/

# Build your container image using Cloud Build
gcloud builds submit --tag gcr.io/mg-ce-demos/dcc-slack-app

# Deploy the image to Cloud Run
gcloud run deploy dcc-slack-app \
  --image gcr.io/mg-ce-demos/dcc-slack-app \
  --platform managed \
  --region us-central1 \
  --allow-unauthenticated \
  --set-env-vars="SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=xoxb-your-token,SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET=your-secret,PROJECT_ID=your-project-id,GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.0-flash-001"
